text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You've caught so many! There was hope
for us
after all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm amazed! You know, looking at these
plushies
really makes me think...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In the next race,
I... I just might make it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all!
N-no one will outshine
me!
